title: HighContrastHomogenization
abstract: A Lean formalization of "Homogenization at a polynomial scale in high contrast" by Armstrong, Kuusi and Loher. The paper studies elliptic equations in random media whose conductivity can vary greatly. It proves that their large-scale behavior becomes predictable at a length bounded by a polynomial in the parameters measuring contrast and randomness, improving earlier bounds. The formalization includes quantitative convergence estimates, approximation by an effective constant-coefficient equation, and large-scale regularity results. It builds on the CoarseGraining library.
